config.cgcconfig.key.hold_to_aim.desc: True if you want to hold the right mouse button to aim

config.cgcconfig.render.bullet_hole_part: The existence time of bullet hole particles, in tick
The threshold for fading out when rendering bullet hole particles
config.cgcconfig.render.crosshair_type.d: The crosshair when holding a gun
config.cgcconfig.render.hit_marker_start: The starting position of the hit marker
config.cgcconfig.render.head_shot_debug_: Whether or not to display the head shot's hitbox
config.cgcconfig.render.gun_hud_enable.d: Whether or not to display the gun's HUD
config.cgcconfig.render.kill_amount_enab: Whether or not to display the kill amount
config.cgcconfig.render.kill_amount_dura: The duration of the kill amount, in second
config.cgcconfig.render.target_render_di: The farthest render distance of the target, including minecarts type
config.cgcconfig.render.first_person_bul: Whether or not to render first person bullet trail

config.cgcconfig.render.enable_resource_: Enable the display of the ResourceLocation in the tooltip when Advanced Tooltip is enabled
config.cgcconfig.render.block_entity_tra: Enable translucent while render block entity or not. Enable this option will result in ADDITIONAL PERFORMANCE OVERHEAD.
config.cgcconfig.resource.enable_lazy_cl: Build heavy TACZ client assets such as models and animation state machines on demand.
config.cgcconfig.sound.hit_sound_concurr: Max active hit marker sounds for the same entity and sound id. 0 disables this limit.
config.cgcconfig.sound.default_sound_con: Max active normal gun sounds for the same entity and sound id. 0 disables this limit.
config.cgcconfig.sound.high_frequency_so: Max active high-frequency gun sounds, such as shooting and animation keyframe sounds, for the same entity and sound id. 0 disables this limit.
config.cgcconfig.sound.first_person_anim: Use a non-relative entity-tracking world sound source for first-person animation keyframe sounds. This can improve compatibility with physical sound mods, but may introduce slight stereo drift while moving.
config.cgcconfig.zoom.screen_distance_co: Screen distance coefficient for zoom, using MDV standard, default is MDV133
config.cgcconfig.zoom.zoom_sensitivity_b: Zoom sensitivity is multiplied by this factor
config.cgcconfig.ammo.explosive_ammo_des: Warning: Ammo with explosive properties can break blocks
config.cgcconfig.ammo.explosive_ammo_fir: Warning: Ammo with explosive properties can set the surroundings on fire
config.cgcconfig.ammo.explosive_ammo_kno: Ammo with explosive properties can add knockback effect
config.cgcconfig.ammo.explosive_ammo_vis: The distance at which the explosion effect can be seen
config.cgcconfig.ammo.pass_through_block: Those blocks that the ammo can pass through
config.cgcconfig.ammo.destroy_glass.desc: Whether a ammo can break the glass
config.cgcconfig.ammo.ignite_block.desc: Whether a ammo can ignite the block
config.cgcconfig.ammo.ignite_entity.desc: Whether a ammo can ignite the entity
config.cgcconfig.ammo.global_bullet_spee: Global bullet speed modifier, the init speed of the bullet will be multiplied by this value.

config.cgcconfig.other.target_sound_dist: The farthest sound distance of the target, including minecarts type

The maximum latency (in milliseconds) for the server hitbox latency fix saved
